title: Skip corpus-cache lineage tests when the cache dir is missing
description:
CI \`pnpm test\` fails on runners that have never materialized benchmark packets:

\`ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir tests/benchmark/.cache/repos\`

in \`tests/unit/data-flow/intra-component-lineage.spec.ts\`. Those tests already intend to no-op when a packet is absent; they must also no-op when the cache directory itself is absent.

Do not clone in CI.
